tests.label: chromium/phone
steps: injected runtime and real map surface
selection changes time scale without rewinding the world
attention changes pace without stopping playback
dated positions and reversible movement share one clock
clicking the visible ship selects it at the current date
sparse evidence stays a gap instead of an invented route
outside the voyage has an explicit return without resetting attention
follow control is explicit and can be turned off
timeline drag changes day while map pan keeps it
timeline zoom keeps map camera and current day
actual CDP two-finger time pinch
keyboard map movement pauses playback
backgrounding and Reduce Motion hold the same clock
large text keeps controls reachable
empire overview is the same date at a different scale
runtime close removes handlers and animation

notes: Chromium pinch checks use CDP native touch input, not synthetic PointerEvents.
WebKit pinch checks dispatch PointerEvents with a temporary pointer-capture shim; they verify handler mathematics, not physical-device multitouch delivery.
Simulator/browser checks do not establish physical iPad or iPhone performance.
